Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Oval Plug-In Light Wall Sconce - 8.5 x 4.25 x 13 Inches, Faux Wood and Nickel
Colors: Faux Wood/Brushed Nickel
Materials: Metal+Glass
This Mid-century modern wall sconce has an oval-shaped glass diffuser that will provide warm, ambient light for a bedroom. The opal glass, faux wood socket and metal hardware with a brushed nickel finish give it both modern and vintage touches. 8.5"W x 4.25"D x 13.5"H Faux wood socket, metal arm and wall plate, glass shade Convenient plug-in sconce provides soft light. Rotary on/off switch. Easily assembled and mounted on wall Intended for indoor use only
